Session · What happened (August 17)
The session focused on refining the architecture and implementation details for the RAG system and the Team Intelligence Agent, with a strong emphasis on modularity, reusability, and proper system boundaries. Dakshinya presented an updated system design, which was reviewed and further refined to prepare for deployment.

Technical concepts discussed
- **RAG System Architecture**: Discussion revolved around structuring the RAG system into three main services: a vector store ingestion service, a retrieval service with multiple strategies and a reranker, and an evaluation service [17 August 2026, Page 7 — Siddharth Saminathan].
- **System Boundaries and Modularity**: Emphasis was placed on defining clear boundaries between systems and subsystems, ensuring that each component can function as a service and be independently deployable [17 August 2026, Page 7 — Siddharth Saminathan].
- **Reranker as a Separate Module**: The reranker component, currently used in two experiments, needs to be refactored into a separate, reusable module that can be called by other components or experiments [17 August 2026, Page 8 — Siddharth Saminathan].
- **Context Engineering and Prompt Builder**: The importance of separating context engineering and prompt building into dedicated Python files and a prompt builder service was highlighted to maintain core logic and prevent external modification of prompts [17 August 2026, Page 9 — Siddharth Saminathan].
- **FastAPI for Service Wrapping**: The three main systems (ingestion, retrieval, evaluation) should be wrapped in FastAPI services for deployment and API calls [17 August 2026, Page 10 — Siddharth Saminathan].
- **Quadrant Cloud Deployment**: A practical demonstration of creating a cluster, obtaining API keys, and understanding metrics and logs in Quadrant Cloud was conducted [17 August 2026, Page 14-15 — Siddharth Saminathan].
- **Knowledge Base Design**: Initial discussions on the structure of the knowledge base, including entities like people, roles, tasks, projects, decisions, assignments, terminology, events, and facts, were held. The concept of a "training profile" for each team member, updated daily with facts and observable events, was introduced [17 August 2026, Page 2-3 — Siddharth Saminathan].

Assignments and actions
- **Dakshinya**:
    - Refine the system design to transform the existing Python file into the three defined subsystems (vector store ingestion, retrieval service, evaluation system). For each subsystem, identify the Python modules and their functions [17 August 2026, Page 4 — Siddharth Saminathan].
    - Implement a FastAPI architecture around these subsystems, ensuring modularity and reusability where necessary [17 August 2026, Page 4 — Siddharth Saminathan].
    - Create a separate Python file for context engineering and a prompt builder service, moving hard-coded prompts out of the main Python files [17 August 2026, Page 9 — Dakshinya Nachimuthu].
    - Refactor the reranker into a separate, reusable module [17 August 2026, Page 8 — Siddharth Saminathan].
    - Change the ingestion pipeline to read from Ganesh's database instead of directly from documents, after Ganesh has deployed his normalization layer [17 August 2026, Page 13 — Siddharth Saminathan].
    - Implement proper error handling and callbacks in the LLM generation client and ensure correct logging at every step using a normal Python logger [17 August 2026, Page 5-6 — Siddharth Saminathan].
    - Create a new repository or a new folder within the existing repository for the refactored code [17 August 2026, Page 5 — Siddharth Saminathan].

Decisions
- The RAG system will be structured into three main services: a vector store ingestion service, a retrieval service, and an evaluation service [17 August 2026, Page 7 — Siddharth Saminathan].
- The reranker will be a separate, reusable module [17 August 2026, Page 8 — Siddharth Saminathan].
- Context engineering and prompt building will be separated into dedicated files and a prompt builder service [17 August 2026, Page 9 — Siddharth Saminathan].
- FastAPI will be used to wrap the three main systems as services for deployment [17 August 2026, Page 10 — Siddharth Saminathan].
- The ingestion pipeline will read from Ganesh's database once his normalization layer is deployed [17 August 2026, Page 13 — Siddharth Saminathan].
- A shared GitHub repository will be used for documents instead of MCP for document retrieval [17 August 2026, Page 12-13 — Siddharth Saminathan].

- The reranker needs to be modularized to be reusable across different experiments and services [17 August 2026, Page 8 — Siddharth Saminathan].
- Prompts, currently hard-coded, must be externalized into a separate prompt builder service [17 August 2026, Page 9 — Siddharth Saminathan].
